'''2002 World Championship''' was the first Players Committee Star Wars CCG World Championship, run at DecipherCon 2002 (Chesapeake Conference Center, 1–3 November 2002).<ref name="dcon-fmt">[https://web.archive.org/web/20020810223927/http://www.decipher.com/deciphercon/2002/events/worldsformats.html World Championship Event Formats & Prizes] (Wayback, 10 August 2002)</ref><ref name="tfn">[https://www.theforce.net/ccg/story/World_Championship_Results_announced_64778.asp World Championship Results announced], theforce.net (3 November 2002)</ref>

[[Angelo Consoli]] won. [[Greg Shaw]] finished 2nd. 3rd and 4th were [[Brian Terwilliger]] and [[Brian Fred]]. 5th–8th: [[Hayes Hunter]], [[Jonathan Chu]], Brian Rippetoe, [[Bastian Winkelhaus]].<ref name="tfn" />

The constructed pool was printed sets through [[Theed Palace]] plus original virtual cards through [[Virtual Set 3 (Original)|VS3]] (20 September 2002). Shaw posted a Light [[There Is Good In Him]] list on DeckTech (DCon2k2 Runner Up - LS). [[Angelo Consoli]] posted the Dark [[No Money, No Parts, No Deal!]] Watto 60 that won.

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Theed Palace]] + [[Virtual Set 3 (Original)|VS3]]
* '''Dates:''' 1–3 November 2002
